verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Netlify integrating with an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) to protect internal apps, deployments, or agents. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: team-level access management, password protection and Advanced Security, Netlify's own built-in identity for site auth, and a third-party Clerk template.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
